---
title: "New York Central Park NOAA Weather Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
library(p8105.datasets)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
data("ny_noaa")

central_park =
  ny_noaa |>
  filter(id == "USW00094728") |>
  separate(
    date,
    into = c("year", "month", "day"),
    convert = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    snow = as.numeric(snow)
  )
```

Column {data-width=550}
----------------------------

### Daily Maximum vs Minimum Temperature

Daily minimum and maximum temperatures recorded at Central Park from 1981 to 2010.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
central_park |>
  filter(
    !is.na(tmax),
    !is.na(tmin)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c(
      "Date: ", year, "-", month, "-", day,
      "\nMinimum: ", tmin, "°C",
      "\nMaximum: ", tmax, "°C"
    )
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin,
    y = ~tmax,
    color = ~year,
    colors = "viridis",
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    text = ~text_label,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Minimum Temperature (°C)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)"),
    margin = list(b = 100)
  )
```



Column {data-width=450}
----------------------------

### Maximum Temperature by Month

Distribution of daily maximum temperatures at Central Park across months from 1981 to 2010.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
central_park |>
  filter(!is.na(tmax)) |>
  mutate(
    month = factor(
      month,
      levels = 1:12,
      labels = month.abb
    )
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month,
    y = ~tmax,
    type = "box"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temperature (°C)"),
    margin = list(b = 100)
  )
```



### Snow Days by Month

Total number of days with recorded snowfall at Central Park by month from 1981 to 2010.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
central_park |>
  filter(
    !is.na(snow),
    snow > 0
  ) |>
  count(month) |>
  mutate(
    month = factor(
      month,
      levels = 1:12,
      labels = month.abb
    )
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month,
    y = ~n,
    type = "bar"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Snow Days"),
    margin = list(b = 100)
  )
```
